discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B041 (397). 30 standard searches, snippet leads only. Reused 397 keys where the same pin/set recurs (Fun Day 2020 logo, balloon-random, TDS 20th large pin, Fun Day 2021, PTC 2020/2022). Only one earlier hold released: TDR balloon 2020 (MezzoMiki names all 8 designs). Reseller-only items held (Suruga-ya Halloween 2022 pin) or not used (usshoppingsos, dpinstore, fryguypins). World of Frozen pins are 2023. Plush/stuffed badges excluded as non-pin.
